content: Claude Code desktop/Electron apps have a documented, recurring zombie-process bug class: closing a session window does not reliably terminate the underlying claude.exe/PTY subprocess (anthropics/claude-code #54130, #15423), and ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE leaking into child envs breaks nested Electron spawns (#34836). Community has built standalone 'zombie killer' tools because of this. Root cause pattern: PTY/daemon spawned detached+unref, but shutdown only closes the socket/window, never SIGKILLs the tree.
